text:
anika: Dropping updated RFI + capability sheet for Meridian Health. Need SE/Sec/Legal review before we send tomorrow morning. Attached: meridian_rfi_v1.pdf, meridian_capmatrix.csv

samir: quick Q on POC pricing 1: buyer expects ~500 concurrent embed calls. Recommend Hosted credits or Dedicated eval?

anika: I put both. Recommend Hosted with 1-week reserved burst (faster onboarding). Dedicated only if they require tenant isolation.

jorge: POC plan suggestion: 2d warmup / 5d steady / 2d spike. I'll add benchmark_plan.md and a tiny perf harness.

priya: Security review: missing KMS/HSM notes, data residency statement, log retention, SOC2 link. Please fill Q22-Q28 in security_questionnaire.xlsx. Also confirm whether ETA: data ever leaves customer's VPC during ingest.

anika: we'll state collector writes to customer S3; we don't stage PII. I'll make that explicit in the draft.

legal: I'll take legal review. Two asks: tighten POC liability cap and include DPA link. Will upload redlines by 10:30 PT.

files-bot: Uploaded meridian_rfi_v1.pdf (1.9MB), meridian_capmatrix.csv (40KB), benchmark_plan.md (2.2KB)

samir: uploaded po_costs_meridian.csv with conservative/optimistic columns. Note: embeddings buffer +20% for peak.

jorge: Adding a curl smoke-test for infra teams:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embed \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"clinical note test"}'
```

priya: Flag: if they insist on HSM-backed keys on-prem, Private deployment supports it but adds ~3 weeks. Add to constraints.

legal: uploaded meridian_legal_redlines.docx with DPA stub and tightened liability.

anika: great 	60 I'll incorporate edits and send to buyer by 11:00 PT. Please ping when you finish any remaining small changes. :thumbsup:
